Problem Description

The machine cannot connect to the computer through Ethernet or Wi-Fi, or LightBurn cannot find the machine after the connection is set up.

In some cases, the machine may appear connected to the network, but file transfers through Wi-Fi are unstable or fail.

 

Causes

Common causes include:

The computer and machine are not on the same network.

The machine's IP address is not configured correctly in LightBurn.

The computer and machine have different IP address ranges.

The network connection is unstable.

The machine uses UDP communication, which may be affected by an unstable Wi-Fi connection.

 

Solution

1. Check the Machine IP Address

Check the IP address displayed on the machine.

For example, if the machine IP address is:

192.168.1.200

the computer should normally be connected to the same network range, such as:

192.168.1.xxx

The first three sections of the IP address should normally match.

 

2. Check the LightBurn Device Settings

Open the machine/device settings in LightBurn and make sure the IP address matches the IP address shown on the machine.

If the machine's IP address has changed, update the address in LightBurn.

 

3. Check the Ethernet Connection

If using Ethernet:

Make sure the Ethernet cable is securely connected to both the machine and the computer or network device.

Check that the cable is not damaged.

If possible, try another Ethernet cable or network port.

Restart the machine and LightBurn, then test the connection again.

 

4. Check the Wi-Fi Connection

If using Wi-Fi, make sure the machine has a stable connection to the network.

Because Ruida controllers use UDP communication, an unstable Wi-Fi connection may cause dropped packets, failed file transfers, or intermittent communication.

For more reliable communication, use an Ethernet connection when possible.

Note: If the machine can connect successfully through Ethernet but frequently disconnects through Wi-Fi, the issue may be related to network stability rather than the machine itself.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
